profile.name: Imran Darajati
profile.headline: Web Developer & UI/UX Designer
about: An Information Technology (Diploma 3) graduate from Universitas Brawijaya, specializing in end-to-end web application development (Frontend & Backend) and UI/UX design. Skilled in designing responsive interfaces, building RESTful APIs, and managing database architecture.

Experienced as a Frontend & Backend Developer Intern at PT cmlabs Indonesia Digital, with a track record of integrating user-oriented design with scalable system architecture and Git-based version control.

research.narrative: I am passionate about translating complex requirements into accessible, performant, and well-structured web applications. My professional direction centers on building robust backend services, seamless RESTful API communication, and user-centered web interfaces through modern software engineering practices.
